recList.description: sequence data in the same field may be heterogeneous - they will be promoted to the highest data type.

shape.description: int or tuple of ints, optional shape of each array. If `dtype` is ``None``, these arguments are passed to `numpy.format_parser` to construct a dtype. See that function for detailed documentation.
constraints: Required if recList is not a list of records with explicit shapes.

output.description: ------- np.recarray record array consisting of given recList rows.
